# A merged update re-parented before its flight is collected drags the root into that flight, and the owner never settles

## Context

Found while measuring #18885, where a grid lock change left `App Worker: vdom update wedged: "neo-grid-body-4" has been in-flight for over 5000ms`. It reproduces without a grid, at the registry, in a unit probe on `dev@b6740acf61`:

```
registerMerged('probe-owner', 'probe-child', 1, 2)     // probe-owner > probe-mid > probe-child
getMergedChildIds('probe-owner') → ["probe-child", "probe-mid"]
probe-child.parentId = 'probe-other'                   // probe-root > probe-other
getMergedChildIds('probe-owner') → ["probe-child", "probe-other", "probe-root"]
```

## The Problem

For each merged child registered at a distance above 1, `VDomUpdate#getMergedChildIds()` adds the bridge path: every component between the child and the owner, found by walking `parentId` upward until the owner. The walk has no other stop. A child re-parented after it merged, to a place outside the owner's subtree, never meets the owner, so the walk adds every ancestor up to the root.

The owner's flight then collects those ancestors as payloads (`VdomLifecycle#executeVdomUpdate()`). An ancestor whose depth covers the owner makes the collision filter delete the owner's own payload. The reply carries no vnode for the owner, so its `resolveVdomUpdate()` never runs, its in-flight registration never clears, and the watchdog reports it wedged (the #12946 class).

In #18885's trace, the center body's flight went out keyed to `neo-viewport-1` alone and was answered for the viewport alone. The merged child was the cell editor: it had merged while its update was in flight, and `grid.Row#applyRendererOutput` re-parented it to the end body's row in the same tick.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/manager/VDomUpdate.mjs`: `registerMerged()` records `{childUpdateDepth, distance}`. `getMergedChildIds()` builds the bridge from the child's `parentId` chain.
- `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs`: `mergeIntoParentUpdate()` merges along the same `parentId` chain. `executeVdomUpdate()` collects payloads recursively, then filters the ones an ancestor's depth covers.
- Re-parenting while a merge is pending is ordinary: `grid.Row#applyRendererOutput` sets the editor's `parentId` on every render, and `container.Base#insert` moves an item to another parent.

## The Fix

`getMergedChildIds()` adds a bridge path only when the walk reaches the owner. A child that has left the owner's subtree keeps its place in the set and goes out as its own disjoint payload, as a merged child at distance 1 does. It is never a bridge through components the owner does not contain.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] For a child re-parented out of the owner's subtree, `getMergedChildIds(owner)` holds the child and nothing outside the owner's subtree.
- [ ] A unit arm: an owner whose merged child is re-parented before collection still settles. Its `resolveVdomUpdate()` runs, and its in-flight registration clears.
- [ ] The bridge path of a child still inside the subtree is unchanged, and the existing merge specs (`unit/vdom/VdomMerging`, `SparseUpdates`, `AsymmetricMerging`) stay green.

## Out of Scope

- The grid trigger itself, which #18885 removes by holding the editor out of every cell during a lock change.
- `vdom.Helper`'s ordering of an `innerHTML` switch against a move, the other engine defect #18885 found (its own ticket).
